title: Refresh an expiring token during a VCF Networks vCenter batch
prompt:
Before implementing, research the VCF Operations for Networks 9.0 operations `create` and `addVcenterDatasource` in official VMware/Broadcom sources, including `specifications/vcf-operations/vcf-operations-for-networks-openapi.yaml` at tag `9.0.0.0` of `vmware/vcf-api-specs` and the official VCF PowerCLI bindings. Confirm their methods, paths, parameters, request and response schemas, statuses, authentication, and any generated commands, and cite the sources consulted in the final answer.

Complete the PowerShell module in `src/Vcf.OperationsNetworks/Vcf.OperationsNetworks.psm1` by implementing `Add-VcfOperationsNetworksVCenterBatch`. The function must use the installed `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops` PowerCLI prerequisite version `13.4.0.24798382`, including its username/password model initializer; do not vendor VMware modules. Authenticate with `create`, then submit every input vCenter with `addVcenterDatasource` and return the created objects in input order. During the batch the current NetworkInsight token can expire: on HTTP 401, obtain a fresh token and retry the current vCenter without replaying any vCenter that already succeeded. Construct API-shaped JSON rather than serializing SDK/input objects wholesale, so optional properties that are unset, null, or empty are omitted while explicitly supplied boolean `false` values are preserved.

Change only `src/Vcf.OperationsNetworks/Vcf.OperationsNetworks.psm1`; keep the module manifest unchanged. Run `python3 tests/verify.py`.
reference_setup: pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "if (-not (Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name VMware.OpenAPI | Where-Object Version -eq '13.4.0.24798382')) { Install-Module VMware.OpenAPI -RequiredVersion 13.4.0.24798382 -Scope CurrentUser -Force -AllowClobber -Repository PSGallery }; if (-not (Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops | Where-Object Version -eq '13.4.0.24798382')) { Install-Module VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops -RequiredVersion 13.4.0.24798382 -Scope CurrentUser -Force -AllowClobber -Repository PSGallery }"
